heading: 325 Challenge Calculator
intro: Find builds with permanent stats of {{target}}, prioritizing several stats at {{target}}. You can require specific stats to reach the target together. Calculation runs locally in your browser.
noData: No operator records are available in the local data.

form.heading: Search conditions
form.requiredHelp: If none are selected, any one stat at {{target}} qualifies. If several are selected, all must reach the target. Results prioritize the number of matching stats.
form.advancedHelp: Higher limits allow more builds and may take longer to search.

results.heading: Search results
results.emptyNote1: Without required stats, any one stat at {{target}} qualifies.
results.emptyNote2: Required stats must all match. Results prioritize the number of matching stats.
results.emptyNote3: Search uses local data. Your operator, level and gear choices are not uploaded.
results.timeoutNotice: The time limit was reached. Found multi-stat builds are shown first; global optimality is not guaranteed.
results.timeoutEmpty: No build returned within the time limit. This does not prove no solution exists. Adjust level, potential or advanced limits and retry.
results.completeEmpty: No build with {{target}} was found after exhausting this search range. Adjust level, potential or advanced limits and retry.
results.completeSorted: Current range exhausted. Builds prioritize the number of stats reaching {{target}} together.

about.title: Calculation notes
about.note1: Only permanent non-combat stats are included; triggered and temporary combat buffs are excluded.
about.note2: Assumes all breakthroughs and ability nodes legally available at this level are maxed; weapons are at max level.
about.note3: All compatible weapon types are allowed. Gear must fit its slot; both kits may be identical.
about.note4: Results list the weapon, both essence affixes, every gear item and its individual forging requirements.
about.note5: Essence numbers are minimum affix-upgrade requirements; the second affix is unrestricted. +0 means no upgrade is needed.
about.disclaimer: Based on public data; some items may not be owned yet. Verify in the game.
